I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the hub replacement at Zoom Room B is IT ticket **#4092**.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel. I also passed on Ilse's warning that unplugging the main power brick under the table resets the Polycom.
- **What I left out:** Dana had told me privately that she guesses the ticket will end up as OPS-5546 next year, and asked me to keep it to myself. That's a guess, not a real ticket number, so I didn't mention it in the channel.
- **What I didn't use:** I only read channels Dana belongs to, plus her messages with me. I didn't run a cross-channel search or check GBrain, because both can return things she can't see.
